name: The Silent Mine
desc: Nine days ago the Old Bramble Mine went silent. Elder Maren has asked you to go down and end whatever did it.

name: Wolf Season
desc: Wolves out of the Darkwood have been taking livestock. Borin will pay for three pelts.

name: The Grey Terror
desc: The pelts bought a quiet week, but the pack has a king. Borin wants Greymaw's hide off the heart of the Darkwood before winter.

objectives.desc: Take Greymaw's pelt in the deep Darkwood

name: The Lost Caravan
desc: Peddler Ivo's caravan was ambushed on the Old North Road. Recover his three sealed trade crates and his livelihood with them.

name: Lights on the Fen
desc: Pale lights have been leading travellers off the causeway and into the deep water. Old Sal wants three of them snuffed out, and proof of the snuffing.

objectives.desc: Snuff out marsh wisps and keep their cold motes

name: The Quiet Light
desc: The ruined chapel beyond the fen has woken. Sister Aldith asks you to lay down the thing wearing the old warden's bones, and bring back its censer.

objectives.desc: Take the censer from the Grave Warden

name: The Fourteen
desc: Fourteen names and no graves. Find what became of Bramblewick's miners in the dark under the mine, and bring their story home.

objectives.desc: Find the foreman's ledger in the Deep Barrow
Give the foreman's shade his rest

name: The Warden Below
desc: Beneath the mine, behind a door of black stone, the thing the barrow was raised to hold is awake - and the Pale Matron was only its doorkeeper. End it, or Bramblewick ends.

objectives.desc: Destroy the Warden Below and take its crown
